reader.requirement: At 85, OPEN INPUT of an absent OPTIONAL relative file succeeds (05) without creating it and leaves the file position indicator at 'optional input file not present', so the first sequential READ (any access mode) is at end 10 (later ones 46), and a START or format 2 READ is the invalid key 23; OPEN I-O of an absent optional file creates it instead and is outside the rule.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002+): at 85 every OPEN takes the AllOther file lock and Table 19 is not consulted; no effect on open-mode or position rules

reader.edition-search: grep OptionalAbsent and Edition/IsActive over FileConnector, KeyedConnector, RelativeConnector: the absent-optional state is set in OpenCore's INPUT arm and read by the guards with no edition test.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_optional_input_absent covers dynamic relative OPEN/START/READ NEXT; sequential and random access, the second sequential READ (46), repeated random READ, and the I-O creation contrast are not exercised

probes.printed: sequential: OPEN 05, READ at end 10, second READ 46 via USE, CLOSE 00, re-OPEN 05 (not created), START invalid 23; random: OPEN 05, READ 23, READ 23; dynamic: OPEN 05, START 23, random READ 23, READ NEXT at end 10; OPEN I-O of absent optional: 05, READ NEXT 10, WRITE 00, reopen 00 and reads CCC1 (MATCH)
probes.expected: 1985 VIII.1.3.4 05, 10 'for the first time', 23 for START or random READ; 1985 VIII.4.5.4 GR9

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR9  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "sets the file position indicator to indicate that an optional input file is not present"
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "A sequential READ statement is attempted for the first time on an optional input file that is not present"
OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "A START or random READ statement is attempted on an optional input file that is not present"
OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR9  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "the invalid key condition exists and execution of the READ statement is unsuccessful"

reader.notes: OptionalAbsent is a state separate from openness, set only by OpenCore's INPUT arm on an absent optional file; SequentialReadGuard tests the 46 poison before it, which makes 10 first-time-only exactly as the 1985 status list words it.

refuter.evidence: r3lock-001 at --std 85, dynamic OPTIONAL absent file: OPEN INPUT 05, format 2 READ 23 (VIII.4.5.4 GR9), READ NEXT after that failed random READ 46 (GR12 overrides the absent-optional indicator, as the text orders). r4open-001: CLOSE of an EXTEND-created file then OPEN INPUT 00 (contrast: only INPUT leaves the file absent). Reader's p4optabs covered sequential/random/dynamic first READ 10, second 46, START 23. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR9 'sets the file position indicator to indicate that an optional input file is not present'; OK §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR12 'no valid next record has been established'.
